distribution: Mount Gaoligong, Tengchong, Yunnan (altitude about 1920 m).
soldier: Head of the soldier deep yellowish brown, the pronotum darker than the posterior part of the head, abdomen pale yellow. Pilosity of the head capsule rather abundant, the middle region of the pronotum with about 30 hairs. Head capsule nearly rectangular, slightly narrowed anteriorly, the fontanelle projecting. Labrum nearly square, the anterior margin nearly straight or faintly concave. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apex slightly curved; the left mandible about 0.65 times the head capsule length and 0.99 times the head capsule width; the inner margin with extremely fine saw-like traces, with another small tooth below the middle, the mandibular basal ridge steep. Lacinia of the maxilla with about 13 marginal hairs. Antennae 14–15 segments, the third slightly larger than the first and about twice the second. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped shallow concavity, its centre forming a U-shaped notch, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave, median emargination index 21–24%, the median longitudinal line distinct. Hind leg 2.5–2.8 times as long as the femur width.
